A=exp(-(((u-.56)/.22)^2+((v-.32)/.34)^2)); B=exp(-(((u-.29)/.17)^2+((v-.77)/.25)^2)); death=clamp(.065+.065*u-.026*A-.014*B,.067,.150); mask=1-smoothstep(death-.012,death,age). Squares implement t*t.
